purpose: Compose vehicle-history evidence, choose disclosure, preview and locally sign/export a report, import and independently verify signed reports, manage browser signing keys, and inspect local activity. A separate server-issued battery certificate is available in Evidence.
primaryGoal: Prepare a selectively disclosed warranty/service/resale report while understanding evidence coverage, privacy choices, and the difference between content integrity, local key recognition and authoritative certification.

dataSources.name: Server battery certificate
dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing certificate API hooks, not local ECDSA vault
dataSources.behavior: Query fetches certificate; mounted panel automatically submits exact certificate/signature to server verification. Badge requires matching mutation variables, nonpending success and valid=true. Manual retry and separate certificate/signature clipboard actions remain.
dataSources.trustBoundary: Hook describes HMAC signature. Public server validation is not buyer-side ECDSA verification; backend issuer/key custody/authentication/expiry semantics were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.name: Disclosure/report assembly
dataSources.behavior: Fresh visit defaults to resale, VIN excluded, day precision; selection is not persisted. Page useMemo assembles live report from selection/evidence; section filtering repeated in builder. Report IDs/times generated locally.

dataSources.name: Signing keys and audit log
dataSources.behavior: IndexedDB teslasync-resale-vault stores signing_keys/key_registry/audit_log; memory fallback when persistence unavailable. Private keys generated nonextractable. Local audit is bookkeeping, not a cryptographic proof chain.
dataSources.trustBoundary: ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signs canonical report bytes; embedded public JWK enables local verification. Neither mathematical validity nor local key recognition establishes identity, Tesla endorsement or accuracy of source measurements.

architectureIssues.detail: Intro claims nothing leaves browser until explicit export, but Evidence mounts BatteryCertificatePanel which automatically POSTs certificate/signature for verification (lines 46-50). Certificate copying is independent of report disclosure. Server certificate includes vehicle_id and exact issue/expiry times.

architectureIssues.detail: normalizeSoftwareUpdates receives no precision and copies installedAt unchanged (line 147), despite exactTimestamps=false and manifest claiming all report timestamps are day-truncated (redaction.ts:160). architectureIssues.detail: Service notes are copied as free text; vehicle display_name also passes through (line 75). Warranty scrub drops sensitive key names but preserves string values (redaction.ts:80). These paths do not substantiate the absolute claim that identity/addresses are always absent from arbitrary source content.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep useful evidence and disclose limits of key-pattern redaction; establish explicit safe-field/free-text review policy before strengthening privacy claims. Do not treat fixtures or a generated manifest as proof of all-content redaction.

dataBehavior: Workspace vehicle remains sole page vehicle selection; no duplicate selector/date range is introduced.
Evidence inventory is not filtered by disclosure sections; report assembly is filtered defensively by selection.
Disclosure state remains session-local, initially resale with excluded VIN/day precision.
Preserve all raw numeric measurements, specialty conversion/formatting and full source payload metadata; SI conversions must follow actual source contract, not guessed units.
Retain observed-window and account-wide limitations; no lifetime coverage, per-vehicle service attribution or currency denomination invented.
Preserve report schema/app version, ID, time bounds, selected evidence, redaction manifest, limitations and attestation.
Preserve battery degradation_trend in report evidence even though the current summary does not draw it (evidenceNormalizers.ts:104-107).
Preserve canonical-byte signing, separate SHA-256 digest and ECDSA proof, public JWK, algorithm and local key status.
Retain crypto-unavailable errors and session-only storage limitations; no fixture/unsigned/hash-only proof fallback.
Local registry recognition/revocation is separate from cryptographic validity; unknown external key is not inherently invalid.
Local audit is neither part of signed report nor authority/immutable-proof infrastructure.
trustBoundaries: Fixture-fed tests or source annotations are not evidence that real Web Crypto signatures verify.
A matching digest alone establishes neither authorship nor measured source accuracy.
Embedded-JWK ECDSA validity proves possession of the matching private key for signed bytes, not person/vehicle identity, Tesla endorsement, legal validity or authenticity of upstream measurements.
Passport provenance hash is displayed without this page invoking passport verification.
Server certificate verification trusts the existing server response and must remain distinct from local self-attestation; no backend verification/runtime proof claimed.
Hard-exclusion manifest is a policy description, not proof that arbitrary free-text values contain no sensitive data.
